entries.text: Financial-2525 — the MoT Financial System (operator 2026-09-30, six addenda, three handwritten MoT sheets transcribed): document real-time transactions; financial management in 91-day quarters with day 365 down; the year resets at perihelion, Austin CST standard; $/min of an individual's financials; the ◬ ♡ 웃 Session as the wireframe basis; revision control from the first line, the Drone-2525 way; each user their own login; deposits with a deposit day and time and a MoT length for real-time accrual; escrow that releases $/min, withdrawable 3 h after the deposit; all time in A.B..C from the Celestial-2525 scale, convertible to Earth LTU and to Mars; the personal budget to $/min and $/sec; twelve lenses until simulated sufficiently; the 9,999 HI token cap; personal first, business after feedback; v.000_r.001; the UI/UX shell starts from the ◬ ♡ 웃 Session (addendum 7 — folded in r.002). Persisted verbatim, sha256 7dc5bd9494b76064e9e349b8c353c0a520b4041c3a074f46f89577235aab49db.

Nine decisions on the record for revision 0.001 (docs/financial-2525/financial-2525.v.000.json decisions[]): (1) MoT in A.B..C is the elapsed fraction of one whole in Base-3600 — 0.0000..0000 at the start, 3600.3600..3600 at completion, the celestial orbit convention; (2) CST standard is UTC−6 all year; (3) released money is withdrawable from exactly 3 h after the deposit; (4) the pay MoT is 30.333 days = 91 ÷ 3, the personal month 33 days; (5) release is linear from the deposit instant; (6) personal first, business after feedback; (7) the cloud half is honest — per-login Supabase isolation waits on the login being wired into Supabase; (8) version 000 · revision 0.001 · stamp v.000_r.001; (9) the 9,999 웃 cap is YUG_CEILING, reused.

The twelve-lens review of the MoT notes runs as round 1; the ◬ ♡ 웃 Session shell (addendum 7) is r.002's first item.

A.B..C IS the Earth's revolution around the Sun (operator addendum 10): one revolution, perihelion to perihelion, split into 3600 A-units · 3600 B sub-units · 3600 C sub-sub-units. r.001–r.002 read a pay period as its own whole, so its end printed 3600.3600..3600 — corrected in r.003: an instant's A.B..C is its position in the current revolution (the sourced perihelion instants), a MoT length converts INTO the scale (the 30.333-day pay MoT ≈ 298.97 A; on Earth one A = 8,766 s, one B = 2.43 s, one C = 0.68 ms; a 30-sol MoT on Mars = 161 A of the Martian revolution), and the chart's reveal reads the revolution's coordinate at each axis mark. FIN-01 superseded by FIN-01.01; FD-13 supersedes FD-01. The record keeps both readings.

v.000_r.003 SHIPPED — A.B..C is the revolution: mot.ts corrected (EARTH_REVOLUTION_DAYS 365.259636 · spanABC / daysOfSpanABC / orbitUnits · motABC as the position within one revolution), the chart's reveal reads the revolution's coordinate at each axis mark and the elapsed span in A-units, FIN-01 superseded by FIN-01.01, FD-13, the CRS matrix carrying both. The stop rule for "until simulated sufficiently" adopted as FD-14: one full real MoT on the operator's phone with a withdrawal and his feedback persisted; two consecutive converging rounds; determinism on two devices × nine runs; every named gate green; no redeclared primitive; the ×32 fill landed; LIVE verified. The lenses' owed list — one perihelion table, one MoT number on glass and gate, a withdrawal checked at every instant, the chart's available series and hold vertex, a record that survives a full phone, no machine word on the person's screen — is r.005's backlog. Addenda 6–10 supersede any lens reading they contradict.

The 365-day financial year IS 3600 A exactly (operator addendum 11, clarified: "365 days is 3600.0000..0000 … Half year … = 1800"): one A = 8,760 s; r.003 measured lengths on the 365.259636-day mean anomalistic year (298.97 A for the pay MoT) — superseded: 91 ÷ 3 days = 299.0641..0345 A; the day · hour · minute · second ladder is DERIVED from the scale (one day = 9.3106..3058 A); every writing prints its true A (365 d → 3600.0000..0000; r.003 substituted 3600.3600..3600); positions are never clamped and flagged past day 365; the fourth tier D (A.BBBB..CCCC...DDDD, 0.18776 µs) is declared. Every planet's whole is its own revolution, perihelion to perihelion (addendum 12: Mars 686.98 Earth days, 668.5991 sols the future form); A.B..C is the standard for all planets, converted to the planet's LTU — Earth hours · minutes · seconds for Mars for now — from the PER-PLANET LTU TABLE, now MASTER DATA IN THE ADMIN PANEL under the seed law (Business Setup › Planet LTU; the cloud config bundle), read by Financial-2525 so an edit adjusts every conversion with no code change. For now the Earth row reads Month = 91 with one system-offline day on Dec 31 (addendum 13): the calendar year is the default anchor, Dec 31 the offline day 365, the perihelion anchor selectable. The reveal is the MoT-icon ⇄ Clock-icon toggle, one state for the card. FIN-01.01 → FIN-01.02 · FIN-02 → FIN-02.01 · FIN-13 → FIN-13.01 + FIN-13.02 · FD-15..18. The lenses' round-1 backlog carries to r.006.
